# Password Generator 1.5.3

This patch release hardens handling of explicitly revealed passwords and completes the Russian application-name localization.

## Security & privacy
- Android screen capture is blocked only while a generated password is explicitly revealed, reducing screenshot and Recents-thumbnail exposure while leaving the normal masked interface capturable.
- Password-bearing generation results and UI state redact the password from `toString()` output to prevent accidental disclosure through future logging or diagnostics.
- Added regression tests that verify secret values are not exposed by those string representations.

## Localization
- The application name is now displayed as `Генератор паролей` when Android uses the Russian locale.

Password generation, persisted settings and the existing UI flow remain otherwise unchanged.
